standard.summary: 单独设置文本编码器（CLIP/T5 等）的学习率，通常设为 UNet LR 的 1/2 ~ 1/10。
standard.effect: 较低的 TE LR 保留预训练语义理解能力，同时允许 TE 适配新概念（如角色/风格触发词）。
standard.whenToUse: 训练包含 TE 时（train_text_encoder=true），建议单独设置 TE LR 使其低于 UNet LR。

standard_en.summary: Sets a separate learning rate for the text encoder (CLIP, T5 and so on), usually 1/2 to 1/10 of the UNet LR.
standard_en.effect: A lower TE LR preserves the pretrained semantic understanding while still letting the TE adapt to new concepts (a character or style trigger word, say).
standard_en.whenToUse: When the TE is part of the training (train_text_encoder=true), it is advisable to set the TE LR separately and keep it below the UNet LR.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Setting it is meaningless when train_text_encoder=false.

advanced.principle: TE 的语义表征空间比 UNet 更「脆弱」，过高 LR 会破坏 CLIP 的语义一致性，导致提示词响应变弱。
advanced.tradeoffs: TE LR=0 相当于不训练 TE；过高 LR 导致语言理解退化。经验值：UNet LR / 5 ~ UNet LR / 2。

advanced_en.principle: The TE's semantic representation space is more "fragile" than the UNet's; too high an LR breaks CLIP's semantic consistency, weakening prompt responsiveness.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: TE LR=0 is equivalent to not training the TE; too high an LR degrades language understanding. Rule of thumb: UNet LR / 5 ~ UNet LR / 2.
